run_sample_and_compress: run trajectory sampling and compression from HuggingFace datasets with custom sample size and output name
sample_from_datasets: sample trajectories from HuggingFace datasets, filter by minimum token count, and randomly select from the combined pool
load_dataset_from_hf: load a HuggingFace dataset by name and return a list of trajectory entries as dictionaries
save_samples_for_compression: save sampled trajectory entries to batched JSONL files in a specified output directory
merge_output_to_single_jsonl: merge all JSONL files in a directory into a single consolidated JSONL output file
